name: uninstall_installed_plugin
description: Resolves install_generated_plugin's 'already installed' conflict: frees the plugin's slot entirely -- distinct from plugin_ops's 'stop', which keeps the slot. Does not touch the plugin's local dev store registration, if any -- call delete_registered_plugin separately if that also needs removing. This is a real, permanent change on the hub -- always confirm with the customer first.

plugin_id.description: The plugin's real profileNum, from list_installed_plugins. Never guess this from a plugin's display name.
